_doc: Registry of QA checks. severity: hard = files a GitHub issue (once QA_REPORT_ONLY is off), soft = weekly summary only. born_from = the real incident that created the check (rule: every manually found defect becomes a check + a fixture, see CLAUDE.md).

web.status.born_from: Q0 baseline: any sitemap URL or internal link that is not a clean 200 (the 'unpublish never gated the site' class, 2026-09-03)
web.status.what: HTTP status != 200 for a sitemap URL, redirect chain > 2, or a broken internal link

web.console.born_from: /today Tonight/Tomorrow script dead in production since Fas 1 (2026-10-21)
web.console.what: console.error, uncaught page error or failed first-party request

web.duplicate-content.born_from: University digest finding 2026-10-23: /university/ showed the long digest text as cards and the digest page showed the same text again (list vs detail). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_duplicate_university_2026-10-23.json
web.duplicate-content.what: a page is mostly (> 60 %, 8-word shingles, pages >= 300 chars) made of text already on a page that links to it; BOTH pages are flagged

q3.pair-review.born_from: University digest finding 2026-10-23 (list vs detail page); weekly AI review of list + detail pair: does the detail page add anything the list lacks, and does old content take too much room
q3.pair-review.what: AI review of a list page and its detail page side by side (qa/q3)

web.literal.born_from: Q0 baseline (spec item: undefined/NaN/null/--); extended 2026-10-23 after a stray ')}' showed under the navigation on every page for two days (leftover '</nav> )}' in BaseLayout.astro; the header is outside <main>, so the check now also reads shellText). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_literal_stray_header_2026-10-23.html
web.literal.what: visible 'undefined', 'NaN', 'null', '[object Object]', 'Invalid Date', '{{', '}}', '${', ')}' or a lone '--', in <main> or in the page shell (header, nav, footer)

web.title-dup.what: the same <title> on more than one URL in a run

web.leak.born_from: culture essay on moreno_valley_ca that belonged to Brookings (2026-08, see CONTAMINATION_REPORT.md)
web.leak.what: another town's identity term (ai_pipeline/town_guard.py HARD_BLOCKLIST) in <main>, title, meta description or img alt

ops.scrape-liveness.what: a town has had no successful scrape_runs row for 26 h

ops.qa-liveness.born_from: 2026-10-28: qa/web/run.mjs had a syntax error from 2026-10-24 and no QA ran for four days without anything complaining; watchdog scripts/check_qa_liveness.py on GitHub's own schedule
ops.qa-liveness.what: qa-daily has not finished green for 30 h

ops.sport-freshness.what: an active sports source has had no successful run in sport_sources_health for 26 h

web.empty-link.what: a link in <main> whose href is empty

meetings.unknown-organ.born_from: Phase 3 meetings 2026-11-05: Brookings' BODIES table said "all 134 rows checked" yet six organs in the database were missing from it (they fell back to their own name). Built for every town. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_meetings_2026-11-05.json; the list itself is also printed by site/scripts/dump-meetings.ts.
meetings.unknown-organ.what: a meeting card whose organ string is in no BODIES table of its town (config/meetings.ts); the card still shows under the source's own name

events.text-names-utc-day.born_from: Owner report 2026-11-05 (premium Phase 4): evening events on Moreno Valley showed a text date one day off. Measured in the live DB 2026-11-05: of 150 upcoming Moreno events whose local day differs from their UTC day, 72 have stored AI text naming only the UTC day (e.g. event-67503, 16:00 PST Dec 7, text says "December 8"). Regression fixture: site/src/lib/event-day-view.test.ts (event-327253, 19:00 PST) - fails with UTC day math, passes with local; bodyNamesWrongDay() is the detector.
events.text-names-utc-day.what: stored event text that names the UTC calendar day but not the local one. /events/ no longer prints the text (rows use occurs_at in the town zone); /s/<slug>/, /today/ and the facet pages still print it. RESOLVED 2026-11-06 by owner decision (stop printing, no regeneration): every layout prints story text only through publicBody() (site/src/lib/ai-text.ts); regression fixture site/src/lib/ai-text.test.ts (fails if a layout reads story.body without publicBody; it failed on LeadStory and WeeklyRoundup before they were fixed).

web.event-big-tile.born_from: Owner report 2026-11-06 (Moreno Valley front page, 390 px): the top event of a day was a large card with a full-size coloured FallbackTile and no real image, and it was lifted above earlier events. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_event_tiles_2026-11-06.json (driven by site/src/lib/qa-checks.test.ts); source-level guards in site/src/lib/event-day-view.test.ts.
web.event-big-tile.what: inside a date-tile events list ([data-pop-list]): any picture or FallbackTile, or a date/time tile taller than 80 px; a picture in the event lists of /tonight, /this-weekend, the week roundup or the university digest; or the markup those pages used before the 2026-11-09 rollout (.ev-card highlight cards, .ev-row event rows, .wk-row, the /tonight category swipe rows). The lists show text and a tile only. Pass E loads /tonight, /this-weekend, this week's roundup and the newest university digest, noindex ones included. (Until 2026-11-09 the probe looked at .evd day lists, which no longer exist, and passed trivially.)

build.internal-note.born_from: Broomfield AdSense audit 2026-11-11 (F6): /facilities/broomfield-recycling-center/ showed "see NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW.md for the open discrepancy" in its lede and a cut-off meta description (data/facilities/broomfield_co.json). build.internal-note.what: a built page whose visible text, <title> or meta description contains NEEDS-HUMAN-REVIEW, a .md file name, a code path (lib/... .ts, configs/... .json), re-verify, TODO, PENDING or FIXME (scripts/verify_no_internal_notes.mjs on dist/ in every deploy workflow). Extended 2026-11-11 after a scan of data/facilities found 'see lib/town-boundary.ts' (Moreno farm-house-collective) and 're-verify this address in ~6 months' (Broomfield station 68).

build.meta-description.born_from: Broomfield AdSense audit 2026-11-11 (F6): 24 facility meta descriptions in all four towns were cut mid-sentence and given a period ("...named for former City and County Manager George Di."); owner: rule it out for every meta description. Fixed in meta-description.ts (wholeSentences, template fallback, a word cut ends in an ellipsis). Regression: site/src/lib/meta-description.test.ts (every facility in data/facilities; it failed on 23 before the fix).
build.meta-description.what: an indexable page whose meta description is missing, ends in a word cut, has no sentence end, or contains ' -- ' (scripts/report_meta_descriptions.mjs, which also writes every description to a TSV for reading)

build.town-games.what: dist/games/ holds a file the building town does not own (scripts/verify_town_games.mjs in every deploy workflow)

data.ai-meta-gate.what: a story query in site/src/lib/db.ts selects stories.meta without the AI_META_GATE expression (ai:* meta only with _checked from scripts/validate_ai_meta.py); vitest in every deploy's test job

build.holiday-timeless.born_from: Owner 2026-11-11: from Nov 12 /veterans-day/ would show its 2026 rows in the past tense ("Veterans Day 2026 was Wednesday", "Held Nov 11", "Operations ran 24/7") on the standing page. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_holiday_timeless_2026-11-12/before (reconstructed from the pre-change view, since the page turns standing only on Nov 12), tests/test_verify_election_pages.py; view: site/src/lib/holiday-view.test.ts 'standing (timeless) page'.
build.holiday-timeless.what: a holiday page marked data-holiday-mode="timeless" has a past-tense word (was, were, ran, held, provided, took place, happened) between the H1 and the About box (scripts/verify_no_empty_messages.mjs, every deploy workflow)

build.holiday-hero-weekday.born_from: Owner 2026-11-11: the standing /veterans-day/ hero said "Veterans Day is / Thursday / Thursday, Nov 11, 2027" (weekday twice); it should read "Veterans Day is Thursday, Nov 11, 2027". build.holiday-hero-weekday.what: the ui-hero of a holiday page (hp-title) names the same weekday twice (scripts/verify_no_empty_messages.mjs, every deploy workflow)

build.traffic-empty.born_from: Broomfield AdSense audit 2026-11-11 (F4): /traffic/ was indexable and in the sitemap with only an H1 and a source line while the CDOT feed had nothing near Broomfield. Regression fixture: site/src/lib/traffic-verdict.test.ts (zero incidents -> noindex, one status line with the time of the latest read, no section rule/filters/source line); the sitemap follows the page's verdict (.traffic-verdict.json) and scripts/verify_sitemap_noindex_disjoint.mjs fails if they disagree.
build.traffic-empty.what: /traffic/ with zero listed incidents that is indexable, in the sitemap, or shows a heading or filter without content

build.this-week-meeting-day.born_from: Owner 2026-11-12: /this-week/2026-w46/ listed Broomfield's "City Council Regular Meeting — Tue, Nov 10, 2026" under "Wed Nov 11" and Moreno Valley's "Planning Commission — Thu, Nov 12, 2026" under "Fri Nov 13" (lib/this-week.ts read meeting instants as UTC dates despite meetingsHaveTime). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_this_week_meeting_day_2026-11-12 (before = the live pages), tests/test_verify_this_week_days.py; logic: site/src/lib/meeting-day.test.ts, this-week.test.ts, week-count.test.ts.
build.this-week-meeting-day.what: a meeting row on a /this-week/ page whose data-day-key or day tile is not the date its title ends with (scripts/verify_this_week_days.mjs, every deploy workflow)

logic.holiday-window-local-day.born_from: Investigation 2026-11-12: lib/holiday-calendar.ts opened and closed holiday windows at UTC midnight, so Veterans Day's page and card went evergreen at 5pm MST on Nov 11 itself (and Thanksgiving's 'was' state ran on to 11:00 UTC Nov 28). No built page shows it on a fixed date, so the regression fixture is the vitest: site/src/lib/holiday-evergreen.test.ts 'each town's window opens and closes at the town's own midnight', the Glasgow New Year/summer-time case and 'the old UTC cut' (all three fail on a7f1b8d's holiday-calendar.ts).
logic.holiday-window-local-day.what: a holiday window (pageState/activeHoliday/nextOccurrence) that does not open and close at the town's own local midnight, in any of the four towns' zones (vitest)

build.no-agendalink-schedule-time.born_from: Investigation 2026-11-12: Broomfield story 3447 said 7 PM for the 6 p.m. council meeting of Oct 27; AgendaLink's scheduleTime carries a one-hour error, scheduleIso is correct (agendalink_v1.py). Regression fixture: tests/test_verify_no_schedule_time.py (a .get("scheduleTime"), a .scheduleTime and a SQL ->>'scheduleTime' read each fail; prose naming the field passes; a line marked `verify_no_schedule_time: strip` passes). The model-facing record has the field removed from raw_data (ai_pipeline/publish.py _without_model_hidden_raw_fields): tests/test_publish_model_hidden_fields.py.
build.no-agendalink-schedule-time.what: code in scrapers/, ai_pipeline/, scripts/ or site/src/ that reads AgendaLink's scheduleTime (scripts/verify_no_schedule_time.mjs, every deploy workflow)

build.meta-missing.born_from: Investigation 2026-11-12: every /s/ page whose story text is withheld (ai:* rows, meta-only template bodies that only repeat title + place) was built with <meta name="description" content> -- Brookings 278, Broomfield 38, Glasgow 95, Moreno Valley 748 pages, all noindex, so the indexable-only report never failed. Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_meta_missing_2026-11-12 (before = glasgowloop.co.uk/s/meeting-2026-11-17-15082/ as served on 49e7892), tests/test_report_meta_missing.py.
build.meta-missing.what: any built page, noindex included, without a meta description (scripts/report_meta_descriptions.mjs, every deploy workflow)

build.description-day.born_from: Investigation 2026-11-12: a hand-written proposal example put Bonnie "Prince" Billy (glasgow event-331533) on Saturday 14 Nov; source, page and description all say Sunday 15 Nov. Checking every page found 9 Glasgow series pages (event-series-*) whose description fixed one date ("Saturday 14 Nov 2026", two already past) while the page says "Regular · Sat 10:30am". The first run of the check also found 20 Moreno /s/home-sales-digest-* pages naming the day before the covered month (occurs_at = month's UTC first read in Los Angeles: "Saturday, Aug 31, 2024" on "Covering September 2024"); fixed by giving pages without a date line no day (story-description.test.ts). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_description_day_2026-11-12 (before = /s/event-series-2e15f0f2497a5f8f/ built locally on 416b535), tests/test_verify_description_days.py.
build.description-day.what: a /s/ or /whats-on/ page whose meta description names a day other than its date line's, or names a day while the date line has none (scripts/verify_description_days.mjs, every deploy workflow)

build.description-venue.born_from: Owner 2026-11-12: Moreno /s/event-163864/ "MAIN LIBRARY: Pijama y Cuentos ~ Pajamas & Stories" had the description "... at Main Library,25480 Alessandro Blvd, Moreno Valley, CA 92553, USA, Wed, Dec 16, 2026.". factsDescription() compared only the whole venue_raw (name + street address) with the title; the name alone was left out only when the address was cut for length. The first run found 89 of 795 Moreno /s/ pages (Main Library, Shadow Mountain Park, Lasselle Sports Park, Celebration Park). Regression fixture: tests/fixtures/qa_description_venue_2026-11-12 (before = /s/event-163864/ built locally on 2261bb6), tests/test_verify_description_venue.py.
build.description-venue.what: a /s/ page whose meta description adds "at <place>" when the headline already names that place (scripts/verify_description_venue.mjs, every deploy workflow)
